newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RRTRS-Coles widens Victorian opening hours.
newsitem.headline: RRTRS-Coles widens Victorian opening hours.

text.p: Retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Monday it plans to open 90 of its Coles Supermarkets in the Australian state of Victoria 24-hours a day, seven days a week.
The initiative, which follows the deregulation of shop trading hours in Victoria, would run until the end of daylight saving on March 30 next year, Coles said.
It would then review the program and tailor opening hours to meet the needs of local shoppers where demand was low.
Coles Supermarkets Victorian state manager Laurie Giuseppini said the move would create about 2,000 jobs.
"Most people are working longer weekday hours," he said in a statement. "The new trading hours will allow people to shop when it suits them."
Coles Supermarkets already opened 68 of its 98 Victorian stores 24-hours a day, five days a week, a spokesman said.
Legislation enabling seven-day, 24-hour trading was due to be passed by the Victorian state parliament on Tuesday, he said.
